summary: InterContinental Hotels Group PLC filed a Form 6-K on 18 August 2026 to report a PDMR share transaction. The Chief Human Resources Officer, Tejas Katre, disposed of 804 ordinary shares at $158.90 per share on 14 August 2026, for an aggregate value of $127,757.55, traded on the London Stock Exchange (XLON). The filing only discloses the disposal and is a routine notification of managerial shareholding activity, not a special situation such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are mentioned. The filing has no strategic significance and does not indicate any corporate event beyond routine insider trading disclosure.
